title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Sit on a folded blanket with legs comfortably crossed.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Let the shoulders soften and breathe normally.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Uncross the legs gently and change position.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Stand with feet comfortably apart and weight even.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Soften knees and let shoulders settle.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Relax your arms and sit when needed.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Lie back with knees bent and feet on the mat.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Let the jaw and shoulders soften while breathing normally.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Roll to your side before sitting up slowly.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Find comfortable rest, posture and breathing.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Place hands below shoulders and knees below hips.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Use padding and keep the spine comfortably neutral.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Sit back or come out if wrists or knees hurt.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Begin in tabletop with padded knees as needed.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Exhale and round the spine gently without forcing the neck.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Return to neutral and rest the wrists.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Begin in tabletop with hands below shoulders.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Inhale and lift the breastbone a little with the neck long.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Return to neutral without exaggerating the arch.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Explore gentle spinal movement with control.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Place both hands on a stable chair or counter.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Hinge from hips with knees soft and back long.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Press through feet and rise slowly.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Hold a wall or stable support with both feet down.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Lift heels only a little while keeping support.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower heels slowly and pause.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Keep one hand on a wall and toes of the bent leg down.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Place that heel at the ankle, clear of the knee joint.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Set both feet down before changing sides.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Use stable supports for standing alignment.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Take a comfortable wide stance and turn the front foot out.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Track the front knee over the foot and relax shoulders.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Straighten the front leg and step in carefully.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Use a comfortable Warrior II stance.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Rest the front forearm on the thigh without collapsing.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Return upright before changing sides.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Place a block beside the front foot and shorten your stance.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Hinge sideways and rest the lower hand lightly on the block.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Keep the front knee soft and rise with control.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Learn comfortable leg and arm alignment.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Set up tabletop with hands under shoulders.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Reach opposite arm and leg only as far as hips stay level.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Place hand and knee down slowly and switch.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Start on hands and knees and move knees slightly back.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Keep a long line from knees through hips to shoulders.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Return to tabletop before the back sags.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Sit tall with knees bent and feet down to begin.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Lean back slightly and lift feet only if breathing stays easy.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Place feet down and sit upright.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Coordinate limbs while keeping the trunk steady.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Lie on your front with elbows below shoulders.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Lift the chest gently and lengthen through the neck.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower to a comfortable front-lying rest.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Lie on your front with hands beside the lower ribs.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Lift the chest a little with elbows bent and neck long.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower gently without pushing for height.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Lie back with knees bent and feet planted.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Press evenly through feet for a small hip lift.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower slowly and keep your head still.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Explore small backbends with easy breathing.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Sit on a folded blanket and bring soles together loosely.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Keep feet far enough forward for comfortable knees.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Support thighs as needed and release the legs.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Lie back with both knees bent and feet planted.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Rest one ankle above the other knee without pressing it.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Uncross the leg and change sides.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Pad the back knee and place hands on blocks.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Keep the front foot planted and lift the chest gently.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Move back to kneeling before changing sides.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Explore comfortable hip movement with props.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Stand with feet apart and bend knees a little.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Send hips back with weight through the whole foot.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Straighten legs gently and lower arms.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Place both hands on a stable chair or counter.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Hinge forward and extend one leg behind at a low height.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Set the foot down before changing sides.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Hold a wall and bend the other knee gently.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Hold the foot only if reachable without twisting or pulling.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Release the foot slowly and change sides.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Practise balance with a dependable support.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Place forearms on the mat with elbows shoulder-width apart.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Lift hips only if shoulders stay comfortable and head stays free.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower knees and rest before fatigue.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: With a teacher, squat with both feet grounded and hands on the mat.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Use this grounded setup to discuss wrist loading. Keep feet down.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Shift weight back and come out with the teacher.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Sit on the heels with padding or a bolster if comfortable.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Stay upright while the teacher discusses tall-kneeling preparation.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Use a seated alternative if knees are uncomfortable.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Study wrist, shoulder and kneeling preparation with a teacher.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Stand facing a wall with palms at shoulder height.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Press lightly and keep ribs settled as the teacher directs.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Release hand pressure and step away slowly.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Use blocks and pad the rear knee in a short stance.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Keep the front knee soft and choose a small hip hinge.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Return slowly without sliding farther than you control.

title: Setup and awareness
learningGoal: Keep the lower knee down and hand beneath shoulder.

title: Brief exploration
learningGoal: Open sideways with hips steady and use the top hand as needed.

title: Control and release
learningGoal: Lower hips and change sides with control.

title: Recovery and readiness review
learningGoal: Combine teacher-selected preparation and review individual readiness.
